text:
maria: Quick sync — thinking about a small operator-sim tool to validate multi-region demotes for PII-bound tenants. Main question: if we demote eu-primary to standby, what's the probability a write for an EU-only tenant temporarily lands outside the EU during the cutover? need infra + privacy input.
kevin: +1. Do you mean a full traffic replay against staging proxies, or a lighter probabilistic simulator based on routing maps and lease timelines?
olga: This matters a lot for Private/VPC/private-cloud customers. We can't leak traces for privacy reasons.
sam: deploy-bot: can run canary replays for a small tenant sample and collect metrics (build/tests).
maria: Proposal sketch: operator-sim has two modes — replay mode (replay recorded client traces with headers/ids pseudonymized) and stochastic mode (generate synthetic clients based on distribution). outputs: time-series for cross-region-write-rate, lease-swap events, KV-ownership-evictions, and audit-log-out-of-region counts. produce a single safety_score and a CSV report.
anya: Inputs we'll need: tenant topology (shards + primary region), shard placement timeline, proxy routing rules, client retry/backoff model, and KMS region mapping. Also expected SLA windows for lease handoff.
kevin: instrumentation thoughts: we should use existing per-request region tag + fallback_reason fields. Sim can synthesize simultaneous connections and model jitter/backoff to approximate retries. Also simulate control-plane delays (lease-swap lag).
maria: quick config draft: 
```yaml
mode: replay
tenant_id: demo-tenant
traffic_trace: s3://staging/trace-2026-02-21.json
demote_plan:
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  target_state: standby
  rollout_seconds: 120
safety_thresholds:
  cross_region_write_pct: 0.5
  kv_owner_leak: 0.1
  audit_out_of_region: 0
```
kevin: Important: the sim should also run a post-cutover reconciliation step that validates audit log continuity and flags missing entries so sweeps can run.
leo: Ops note — Dedicated/reserved capacity customers will have very different tolerances. The sim must support per-customer thresholds and an air-gapped run mode for Private deployments.
olga: Privacy: recorded traces must be pseudonymized before export. For Private customers we need an on-prem agent so no trace data leaves their VPC. Document required transforms.
sam: question — who owns this? eng-runtime or eng-infra? my vote: infra owns the harness; runtime owns the lease/lease-swap modeling and per-request tags.
maria: I'll draft an RFC + prototype script. product/legal will define thresholds (e.g., allowed cross-region writes). @jones-legal can you state legal requirements we should hardcode as hard fails vs advisory?
jones-legal: quick take — for regulated EU-only customers: audit_out_of_region must be 0 during and for 24h after any region-demote/cutover. cross_region_write_pct tolerated only for ephemeral metadata non-PII and must be documented in contract.
anya: ok to add automatic rollback if safety_score < 0.95 and audit_out_of_region > 0.
kevin: estimate: prototype for replay harness + metric output + basic console view ~2w (engineer x1 full-time, paired with runtime SME).
maria: plan: I'll build prototype CLI, run it in staging for two demo tenants (one EU-only PII-bound, one global test), and post results in #architecture. will add --airgap flag for private runs.
leo: :thumbsup: please include a small checklist for operators: pseudonymize traces, confirm KMS mapping, run recon sweep after demo.
deploy-bot: build #1234 succeeded for operator-sim prototype.
maria: thanks all — I'll open RFC + repo PR and tag owners when ready.
